title: ALMA and NOEMA constraints on synchrotron nebular emission from embryonic superluminous supernova remnants and radio-gamma-ray connection
question: Test the pulsar/magnetar-driven scenario for super-luminous supernovae by searching for non-thermal synchrotron emission from nascent pulsar wind nebulae using high-frequency radio observations with ALMA and NOEMA.

data.sensitivity: 3-sigma upper limits: SN 2015bn: 87.4 uJy (97.1 GHz), 123 uJy (233.0 GHz); SN 2016ard: 26.0 uJy (97.5 GHz), 15.1 uJy (233.0 GHz); SN 2017egm: 134 uJy (97.5 GHz), 151 uJy (233.0 GHz)

what.value: Open Supernovae Catalog and V-band optical light curve data and spin-down parameters for SN 2015bn

evidence.quote: Working from the Open Supernovae Catalog (cite: OpenSN17), (cite: OKM18) investigated the detectability of radio and millimetre emission from the recent brightest 6 SLSNe with good quality data of SN light curves.
We adopt the values of $B_{*}$, $P_i$ and $M_{\rm ej}$ obtained by (cite: OKM18) with the V band data.

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image ALMA and NOEMA observations and derive upper limits
recipe.method: Calibrate and image ALMA Band 3 and Band 6 data using the ALMA Pipeline in CASA and NOEMA Band 1 data using GILDAS to produce Stokes I images, then measure RMS within 5 arcsec to obtain 3-sigma upper limits.
key_parameters: 5 arcsec aperture for RMS measurement; 3-sigma threshold

recipe.goal: Determine central engine spin-down and ejecta parameters from SN optical light curves
recipe.method: Model optical light curves of the SLSNe to extract dipole magnetic field B_*, initial spin period P_i, and ejecta mass M_ej.
assumptions: K = 0.1 cm^2 g^-1, M_Ni = 0.1 M_sun, E_ej = 10^51 erg, neutron star radius = 12 km

recipe.goal: Calculate time-dependent non-thermal PWN spectra and light curves and compare with radio/mm limits
recipe.method: Solve coupled kinetic equations for electrons/positrons and photons in the expanding PWN and SN ejecta including electromagnetic cascades, synchrotron self-absorption, Razin-Tsytovich suppression, and free-free absorption for three magnetization models.
key_parameters: Crab-motivated: epsilon_B = 0.003, gamma_b = 6e5, q_1 = 1.5; Low-magnetization: epsilon_B = 10^-6, gamma_b = 10^3, q_1 = 1; High-magnetization: epsilon_B = 0.5, gamma_b = 10^7, q_1 = 1; q_2 = 2.5
assumptions: Cosmological parameters h=0.7, Omega_m=0.3, Omega_Lambda=0.7; epsilon_e = 1 - epsilon_B; c_B = 0; gamma_e in [10^3, 10^7]; two cases with and without free-free absorption in singly-ionized CO ejecta
